label: Characterize existence of an attenuation assignment on the actual grounding graph (inference)
rule: Construct the attenuation weights along shortest finite paths from actual roots and use the forward closed-collection theorem
meaning: The equivalence applies to one fixed world and actual concrete grounding relation. The fitted amount halves with each step from a root and the choice of supplier can ignore other incoming edges. The construction gives no reason to assign those amounts to actual esse independently of rootedness.
